title: The write request

milestone.title: From Machine Code to Modern Languages

description:
Lesson 5.06 ended with `print` asking the operating system to write. Model that request. Write:

```python
def write_request(text)    # what print(text) hands to the kernel on Linux x86-64
```

Return a dictionary with:

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `"rax"` | 1: the number of the write system call |
| `"rdi"` | 1: file descriptor 1, standard output |
| `"rdx"` | the number of bytes |
| `"bytes"` | the bytes as a list of numbers: the text in UTF-8, then 10 for the new line `print` adds |

```python
write_request("Hi")
# {"rax": 1, "rdi": 1, "rdx": 3, "bytes": [72, 105, 10]}
```

`list(text.encode("utf-8"))` gives the text's bytes as a list of numbers.
lessonTitle: One Line of Code All the Way Down
